title: Elevator controller
goal: Show an elevator controller with composite travel and door-cycle states.

rubric.must: A visible composite Moving state contains direction-selection, Going Up, and Going Down substates.
A visible composite Door Cycle state contains Opening, Open, and Closing substates.
A call visibly takes Idle into Moving, and a queued call visibly takes the controller from Door Cycle back to Moving.
Closing visibly returns to Open on an obstruction-detected transition.
Idle and Moving visibly lead to Emergency Stop, with reset acknowledged returning to Idle.
The initial marker visibly enters Idle.
